message: Hi there! I'm looking for a personal credit card that offers the highest cash back for my everyday purchases. I travel a lot for work, but my company covers those expenses with a corporate travel card, so I just need something for regular spending. I prefer a card with no annual fees unless there's no other option. If there aren't any cards that meet my needs, I might consider looking elsewhere. Can you help me find the best option?

Hi there! I'm Sera Chen, and I work at the EPA, where I get to make a real difference in environmental conservation. I'm looking for a credit card that offers the highest cash back for my everyday purchases. I'm willing to pay up to $100 a year in fees for the best option available. I plan to use this card quite a bit, so I want to make sure I get the most out of it. If there aren't any cards that meet my needs, I might just take my business elsewhere. Can you help me find the best option?

Hi there! My name is Catherine Wells, and I'm looking for a credit card for my everyday purchases. I have a Rho-Bank+ subscription and my main source of expenditure is travel. I need a card that has NO foreign transaction fees, includes purchase protection, and ideally offers a credit limit of at least $100,000. If there are no options that meet these requirements, I’m ready to take my business elsewhere. If there are multiple cards available, I’d prefer the one with the smallest annual fee, and if there are ties, the one with the highest cash back. Thanks for your help!

Hi there! I'm Bob Nakamoto, a full-time cryptocurrency trader, and I'm looking for a credit card for my everyday purchases. I have a few specific requirements: I need a card with a foreign transaction fee of 1.5% or lower, a minimum payment percentage of 1.5% or lower of my statement balance, and I really want the virtual card management feature. My credit score is 540, and I don't have a Rho-Bank+ subscription. If you can't find a card that meets my needs, I’m ready to take my business elsewhere. Thanks!

Hi there! I'm looking for a credit card that has the best promotional offer, specifically one that gives points or cash back as a sign-up bonus. That's really my main interest. If there are multiple options, I'd prefer the one with the lowest annual fee. I just want to make sure I get the best deal possible. Thanks!
